newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares rebound, seen flat or up on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares rebound, seen flat or up on Monday.

text.p: Polish shares rebounded after a four-session fall and analysts saw them extending gains or flat on Monday on expectations of companies' good October earnings reports, most of them to be released on Monday afternoon.
"I don't think there will be a fall on Monday, we should have either a flat or rising session," said Janusz Oleksak, an analyst at Bank Slaski brokerage.

Some analysts said the market was likely to form a horizontal trend or even fall as new issues on the primary market were sucking capital from the bourse amid a lack of positive signals to spur growth.
The main market's WIG index rose 170.6 points, or 1.3 percent, to 13,562.7, and turnover fell 8.9 percent to 77.6 million zlotys on both markets as 68 issues rose, five fell and seven were flat.
Continuous trade turnover was at 1.5 million zlotys with three stocks rising, two falling and four flat.
NFI units rose 8.4 percent in a 20.1-million- zloty turnover in the regular bourse session and rose 0.4 percent in 19-million-zloty continuous trade.
